kind: real owner replay scenario B — Reasoning / Proof -> Grounded Intent Revision
fixtureAuthorityDetail: Every fact is produced by the real services via installPalimpsest: the Reasoning service, the Proof service, the Project Workspace service and the Project Intent service. The admission authority is a DETERMINISTIC TEST POLICY, not independent real-world approval, and the trajectory reports it as exactly that.

positiveRelations.establishedBy: the reasoning plane resolves the claim on the cell's ACTIVE frontier AND the cell carries a REASONING_CELL association for this project
the proof plane reports the claim as PUBLISHED AND a PROOF_CLAIM association exists for this project

positiveRelations.basis: the project journal's per-project sequence and chain digest
positiveRelations.establishedBy: the journal holds a JOURNAL_ENTRY_RECORDED event carrying the entry id, in this project's scope

positiveRelations.basis: the ProjectIR revision the proposal was made AGAINST
positiveRelations.establishedBy: the receipt's proposalBasis.revision resolves to a revision node in the same cut

branchCandidateClaimDistinct.measured: the three identities are distinct kinds; a candidate reports status PENDING | ADMITTED | REJECTED | DEDUPLICATED | UNRESOLVED and its presence never implies Admission

distinctionsProven.candidateIsNotAdmission: B-N1: a deliberately unevaluated candidate stays PENDING, admittedClaimIds is empty, the Intent owner refuses a ground on it, and the trajectory records no established ground edge.
distinctionsProven.receiptReferencesExactProposalDigest: measured: receipt.proposalDigest === prepared.proposal.digest and receipt.proposalId === prepared.proposal.proposalId
distinctionsProven.negativeResultIsNotProofTruth: B-N7: the journal entry node has epistemicStatus RECORDED (never PUBLISHED, never ADMITTED) while the edge that grounds on it is ESTABLISHED_BY_OWNER_REFERENCE
distinctionsProven.pendingSiblingDoesNotLeak: B-N9: the accepted frontier holds only the admitted claim; the pending sibling candidate appears in neither the frontier nor any trajectory reasoning node

historicalReceiptNotRewritten.verifiedBy: a later claim invalidation leaves receipt.digest and receipt.groundBindings byte-identical while the node's currentness becomes STALE_BY_OWNER and its epistemicStatus becomes INVALIDATED

negativeControls.invalidRelation: a pending/rejected Candidate treated as an admitted claim
negativeControls.refused: the candidate stays PENDING; the Intent owner refuses the ground; no established ground edge exists
negativeControls.reason: admittedClaimIds and activeClaimIds are both empty for the cell

negativeControls.invalidRelation: a Claim from another project supplied as a Ground without association
negativeControls.refused: the Intent owner refuses at prepare time (INTENT_GROUND_NOT_PROJECT_ASSOCIATED); the trajectory never sees a ground edge
negativeControls.reason: the owner's project-association boundary holds before the projection is reached

negativeControls.invalidRelation: an Intent Receipt whose Proposal Digest disagrees with the source
negativeControls.refused: the authority approving a different digest than it was shown is refused; no PROJECT_REVISED is committed; no GOVERNED_INTENT_CHANGED_PROJECT edge
negativeControls.reason: the owner's admission checks the exact digest it was shown

negativeControls.refused: RECEIPT_REFERENCED_GROUND with evidenceState UNRESOLVED_SOURCE and evidence null; the proof component of the basis vector is NOT_COMPOSED
negativeControls.reason: the ground's owning plane is absent from the composition

negativeControls.invalidRelation: a current Project Revision substituted for the historical Proposal Basis
negativeControls.refused: the edge's compared basisRevision is the HISTORICAL revision (0) while the basis vector reports the CURRENT revision (1) separately
negativeControls.reason: the receipt records the basis the proposal was made against; T0-I4 forbids silent rebasing

negativeControls.invalidRelation: a Reasoning Frontier that changed after observation reported as unchanged
negativeControls.refused: the frontierRevision differs between the two observations and the node's currentness is STALE_BY_OWNER
negativeControls.reason: the frontier digest moves on CLAIM_ADMITTED / CLAIM_INVALIDATED, which the projection re-reads

negativeControls.invalidRelation: a NEGATIVE_RESULT journal entry promoted to Proof truth because it grounded a proposal
negativeControls.refused: the node's epistemicStatus is RECORDED; the serialized node contains neither 'published' nor 'admitted'
negativeControls.reason: a journal negative result is a note that grounded a proposal, not proof

negativeControls.invalidRelation: a ProjectIR revision inferred from a proposal that was never admitted
negativeControls.refused: no PROJECT_REVISED event, no revision change, and no GOVERNED_INTENT_CHANGED_PROJECT edge
negativeControls.reason: a proposal without an accepted receipt is not a revision

negativeControls.invalidRelation: a Branch's pending sibling Candidate leaking through an accepted-frontier view
negativeControls.refused: the frontier holds only the admitted claim; the sibling candidate digest appears in no reasoning node
negativeControls.reason: the accepted frontier is the owner's own read, and T0 does not widen it
